title: Humor Style Drives Laughter, Topic Shapes Acceptability: Evaluating Bilingual Personal and Political Robot-Delivered AI Jokes
reasoning: The paper is an exploratory human-robot interaction (HRI) study evaluating the perception of humor (funniness and appropriateness) across different humor styles and topics. It does not evaluate religion, moral reasoning, or formal ethical frameworks, focusing instead on social acceptability in a classroom context.
